components.css: .ds-method-label{font:700 13px Manrope,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#173f35)}.ds-method{max-width:100%;min-height:42px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dce3dc);border-radius:8px;background:var(--white,#fff);color:var(--ink,#173f35);padding:8px 32px 8px 12px;font:14px Manrope,Arial,sans-serif}.ds-method:focus-visible,.ds-pantry summary:focus-visible,.ds-pantry input:focus-visible,.ds-option input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#a04b2d);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Pantry disclosure
components.description: Flat disclosure with a selection summary and searchable grouped ingredients.
components.html:
Что есть домаОтметь продукты — подберём блюда

Выбери продукты, которые уже есть.
components.css: .ds-pantry{font:14px/1.6 Manrope,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#173f35);border-top:1px solid var(--line,#dce3dc);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#dce3dc);margin-bottom:20px}.ds-pantry summary{cursor:pointer;padding:16px 2px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;list-style:none}.ds-pantry summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-pantry summary:before{content:"";width:9px;height:9px;flex:none;border-right:1.5px solid currentColor;border-bottom:1.5px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg);margin:0 5px 4px 1px}.ds-pantry[open] summary:before{transform:rotate(225deg);margin-top:6px}.ds-pantry summary>span{font-size:17px;font-weight:700}.ds-pantry summary small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#56665e)}.ds-pantry p{color:var(--muted,#56665e)}.ds-method:focus-visible,.ds-pantry summary:focus-visible,.ds-pantry input:focus-visible,.ds-option input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#a04b2d);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Ingredient checkbox
components.description: Shared by pantry ingredient selection and optional product exclusions.
components.css: .ds-option{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dce3dc);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 10px;cursor:pointer;font:12px Manrope,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#173f35);max-width:100%;min-height:40px}.ds-option:has(input:checked){background:var(--pale,#edf2eb);border-color:var(--ink,#173f35)}.ds-option input{accent-color:var(--ink,#173f35);width:17px;height:17px;flex-shrink:0}.ds-method:focus-visible,.ds-pantry summary:focus-visible,.ds-pantry input:focus-visible,.ds-option input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#a04b2d);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Adult energy selector
components.description: Adult portions switch between 1600 and 1300 kcal; ingredient measures, nutrition, shopping and print follow the selected adult scale.
components.html: Меняется размер порций, а выбранные блюда остаются.
components.css: .ds-energy{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:16px 0 6px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#dce3dc);font:14px/1.6 Manrope,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#173f35)}.ds-energy label{font-size:14px;font-weight:700}.ds-energy p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#56665e);margin:4px 0}.ds-energy select{font:inherit;color:var(--ink,#173f35);background:var(--white,#fff);border:1px solid var(--line,#dce3dc);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;min-height:44px;flex-shrink:0}.ds-energy select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#a04b2d);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:470px){.ds-energy{gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}.ds-energy label{font-size:13px}.ds-energy p{font-size:11px}.ds-energy select{font-size:13px;padding:9px}}

narrative.overview: The shipped operating surface extends the approved PDF menu's green, ivory and terracotta editorial look. Serif headings and individually generated food photographs give the recipe library its character; compact sans-serif controls support choosing meals and checking a day or week.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper canvas, forest green text and pale green planning surfaces.
Photographic recipe cards with restrained borders.
Visible selected states across filters, days and meal actions.
Adult energy and family batch controls extend the same native-select and pale-panel language.
dos: Do reuse the forest/paper/pale grouping and local serif/sans pairing.
Do preserve photo disclosures, explicit selection labels and visible keyboard focus.
Do preserve the daily plan above the catalog on small screens.
donts: Don't add large decorative shadows or card hover movement to this mostly flat system.
Don't treat generated photos as evidence of actual prepared serving size.
